notes: Manitoba's own personal and corporate income tax, including its refundable credits. Collection and source withholding are performed federally by the Canada Revenue Agency under a collection agreement, so the withholding machinery is in the federal Income Tax Act, R.S.C. 1985, c. 1 (5th Supp.).
